slides.title: Ten seconds, every switch.
slides.body: Four movements, five rounds. That's twenty switches and over three minutes standing still.

slides.title: Chalk isn't a break.
slides.body: Chalk up before 3, 2, 1. Mid-workout chalk is a breather with a nice excuse.

slides.title: Build your station in a line.
slides.body: Rower, bar and box close together, facing the same way. Straps set before the clock starts.

slides.title: Breathe on the way over.
slides.body: Take your breaths walking to the next movement. When your hands touch it, the rep starts.

slides.title: Time one transition.
slides.body: Next workout, get a partner to time your switch from rower to bar. Then try to halve it.
